headline: UK regulator reins in Google's AI search; power spreads out
body: Regulators pushed back on Big Tech. The UK's Competition and Markets Authority ordered Google to let publishers opt out of AI Overviews and model training. The European Commission proposed a Tech Sovereignty Package, including Chips Act 2.0, to reduce reliance on non-EU providers. Both ease Power Concentration, which lowers Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator and lifts Libertarian Utopia. A security lapse added a darker note: attackers tricked Meta's AI support agent into resetting credentials on high-profile Instagram accounts, a knock to Alignment & Control. Egalitarian Utopia moved above Protector God. Horizon Balance is 2.0, up 0.02.
movers_note: Benevolent Dictator -0.6, mostly from the CMA's Google order (-0.24) and the Meta support-bot hijack (-0.19). Enslaved God -0.6, mostly from the CMA's Google order (-0.29) and the EU sovereignty package (-0.14). Libertarian Utopia +0.3, from the CMA's Google order (+0.29) and the EU sovereignty package (+0.14), partly offset by the Meta support-bot hijack (-0.12).
